title: Capitalize Each Word
problem: Read one line of words separated by single spaces. The words use lower-case letters, digits and apostrophes. Print the same words with the first letter of each word in capitals. For example, the quick fox gives The Quick Fox.
starter_code:
# Read one line of lower-case words separated by spaces.
# Print them with the first letter of every word in capitals.

# Write your code here

hints.1: Only the first letter of each word changes. Think about how to treat the first letter and the rest of a word separately.
hints.2: Split the line into words, change the first character of each word and keep the rest, then join the words back together with single spaces. Beware of a helper that also changes letters after an apostrophe.
hints.3:
words = input().split()
result = []
for w in words:
    result.append(w[0].upper() + w[1:])
print(" ".join(result))

failure_explanation: Only the first character of each word becomes a capital; the rest of the word stays as it is. Keep the single spaces between words. Be careful with words that contain an apostrophe or a digit: the letter after an apostrophe must stay lower case.
